spec: D1436 (STORY v0.7.15 §8 row 7): Juniper's short beat at the lanyard step (was the Glimmer pick), new saves only
_about: Ours, not a design copy. New-flow saves (Seal 1 before the pick) never take the Bright Pavilion Tour, so at a Glimmer pick, right after the Tier 1 lanyard is handed over (ACT1_KEEPER_JOIN D1553: Juniper's lanyard step, enrol_lanyard in detail_zz_keeper_join.json, runs pick_log inside its story.seal1 branch; the orchard lean no longer sets a side), Associate Juniper clips the lanyard to the Fernbrook Seal, logs the Seal and takes the holder's photo for the wall beside the Sanctuary crate list. It sets story.tour1_s1, the flag the photo news reads (nw-fernbrook-wall, yo-pavilionwall), and adds 1 to story.tour_unease as the Tour's stage photo does. A save that already took the Tour (story.tour1_s1) never plays it and never gains a second point. Keepers picks never reach it. Save stays pixelpets.save.v2; both flags already ship, nothing is written at load.
_lines: Story's lines (STORY_LINES D2132, Nov 4, 2026): steps 1 and 3 signed, 2 and 4 re-voiced, and a narration step ({pet} won't look at the camera) before the flag. Flags unchanged.

pick_log: Hold still, partner! Your Tier 1 Lanyard clips right onto your Fernbrook Seal. Snap!
Now I log your Seal for the partnership file. One tap... done! Every single Seal counts, you know.
A flash! Your photo goes up on the Pavilion wall, right beside the Sanctuary crate list.
Gorgeous! You'll be the first face on the wall. Have a bright day!
